UI_TrailerCargo_Desc: Items in an open trailer's trunk ride on its bed as real 3D models. Right-click the trailer to arrange them.
UI_TrailerCargo_Enabled_tooltip: Turn off to hide all cargo models. Takes effect within a second.
UI_TrailerCargo_Auto_tooltip: On: cargo is packed onto the bed for you. Off: each item you put in lands scattered, for you to arrange by hand.
UI_TrailerCargo_Max_tooltip: The most models one trailer draws. Items beyond it stay in the trunk unseen.
UI_TrailerCargo_HideTiny: Hide tiny things (nails, screws, tins, wire)
UI_TrailerCargo_HideMedium: Hide medium things (boxes of nails, gas cans, wire coils)
UI_TrailerCargo_HideSize_tooltip: Items of this size stay in the trunk without a model on the bed, so the model limit goes to what you want to see. Only on your screen; other players keep their own settings. Right-click an item in the trunk and choose 'Show on trailer' to draw it regardless.
UI_TrailerCargo_Wait_tooltip: While you move items into or out of a trailer, its bed is not repacked or redrawn until the whole transfer is done; then everything appears at once. Helps on slower PCs when moving many items.
UI_TrailerCargo_Spill_tooltip: A trailer that tips past the point where its hitch breaks loses its load onto the ground. Cars on a car trailer are thrown off it and damaged. A server may turn either off in its sandbox options.
UI_TrailerCargo_Debug_tooltip: Adds 'Log cargo here' to the right-click menu. Writes to console.txt.
UI_TrailerCargo_ClickStack: Click a stack to split it
UI_TrailerCargo_Why_Hidden: hidden by you (right-click: Show on trailer)
UI_TrailerCargo_Why_NoRoom: with no room left on the bed
UI_TrailerCargo_Why_Small: of a size you chose not to draw (Mod Options)
UI_TrailerCargo_ClickItem: Click an item on the bed
UI_TrailerCargo_PadHint: D-pad: pick an item. Hold Y to move it.
UI_TrailerCargo_PadCarHint: D-pad: pick a car. Hold Y to move it.
UI_TrailerCargo_Cars_tooltip: Cars loaded on a car trailer (W900 Semi-Truck) show as the real cars instead of covers. Right-click the trailer to arrange them.
UI_TrailerCargo_ShowCar_tooltip: Select a car with Move, then click here to change how it looks: Car, Cover (a tarp shape, for a car too big for the deck) or Hidden.
UI_TrailerCargo_ClickCar: Click a car on the trailer
UI_TrailerCargo_ClickSwap: Click the car to swap places with
